title: Versioned work observations
requirement: WHEN a semantic transition consumes work, tooling SHALL report its resource observations under the selected versioned ResourceManifest.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Same computation in chunks
scenarios.when: The same admitted computation is collected in one trace and in two technical chunks.
scenarios.then: Its cumulative reference work is the sum of the same semantic charges; physical transitions, helper visits, logical frame depth, physical frame/environment bytes, preparation/serialization bytes, host time/memory, circuit rows/degree, proof/key bytes and ledger fees remain separate fields. sherlock-k-a/1 and sherlock-quint-a/1 retain their unequal terminal charges; sherlock-helper-microstep/1 is a new proposed schedule, without same-fuel equivalence or a measured cost winner.

expected.cumulative reference work: identical sum of the same semantic charges for one trace and two technical chunks
expected.separate fields: physical transitions, helper visits, frame depth, bytes, host time, circuit rows, proof/key bytes, fees

unasserted: values of physical/host/circuit/proof/fee fields (only asserted to be reported as separate, unmeasured fields; no such measurement exists yet)
sherlock-quint-a/1 terminal charge is a retained manifest entry, not an observation of this run

exec.entrypoint: mori simulate --execution-profile sherlock-helper-microstep/1 --source-profile moriarty-sherlock-draft/1 --entry (non-native build) with --chunk N | --chunk-at E [--chunk-events]
